correctness.rationale: Exact residual differences and image mixing reconstruct the AA update. The 2x2 Gaussian noise map is nonsingular with determinant magnitude one; its conditional Gaussian regression gives h, m and v. Integrating the second-order pole numerator near D=0 yields sharp tail constant 2hM2, and conditioning/rescaling yields both pi/2 ridge risk coefficients. Rational identities were independently checked on 375 fixed oracle paths and deterministic quadratures corroborated limits. Proof, not finite tests, establishes the infinite tail/moment statements.

value.rationale: Quantifies a motivated stability gap in noisy acceleration: a strict contraction with an exact deterministic first accelerated solve acquires a nonintegrable accelerated output under any nonzero Gaussian noise. It supplies the exact noise/geometry-dependent tail coefficient and two distinct sharp weak-ridge squared-risk coefficients, allowing precise assessment of ridge strength and normalization. It does not rely solely on a qualitative Gaussian-ratio pole or pretend to prove global convergence.
